verses.text: Ayik toxo ix satel masanil juntzanh anima yuj Jehová ko Diosal, toxo ix eyikej schonhab' heb', slum heb' yet' spat heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chi' ol he sik'el oxeok chonhab' haton juntzanh ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikok.

Oxe' makan ol aj he pojan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhaltak yol junjun makan lu'um chi', hata' skan junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ol he b'oan sb'e'al juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik wach' yalnhej mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, syal sb'at skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Anhej mach smak'ancham junok anima, tato manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', hata' b'at skol sb'a, yik wach' max chami.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh sb'at k'atzitz, tato ay junok heb' winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab', swa k'e'en t'a junxo winh chi', scham winh, a winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab' chi' syal sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

K'inalok junnhej chonhab', najat sb'at sb'e'al, ay smay syamchaj winh yuj junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', smak'ancham winh chi' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, palta manh smojok scham winh, yujto toxonton manh yajk'olok sb'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze sik'kanel oxeok chonhab' b'aj syal skolan sb'a anima.

Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej juntzanh cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex, yujto tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak' lum lum chi' Jehová smasanil t'ayex, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik ol lewanb'ok lum he lu'um chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ol he sik'anel oxeokxo chonhab' stz'akub'ok oxe' chekelxo yaj chi', haton b'aj syal he kolan he b'a.
Icha chi' ol he k'ulej, yik wach' manh komonok ol cham junok anima malaj smul t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yuj heb' anima scham chi'.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh toxon yajk'ol sb'a, a junok winh smaklan yek' junxo winh chi' yik smak'ancham winh, ayik smak'ancham winh chi' winh, sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Tato icha chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil schonhab' winh ix cham chi', a heb' winh schekanb'at yamchaj winh ix sb'at skol sb'a chi' ta', tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a schonhab' yik tz'ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', yik smak'jipaxcham winh.
Manh eyak' niwank'olal jun anima chi', yik wach' max kan schamel junok anima malaj smul t'a eyib'anh, yik wach' ol aj eyelk'ochi.
Ha t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, manh he k'ex stz'akanhil he lum aykanem yuj he mam eyicham yik tze tok'an ek' yik junokxo mach ay yik t'a stitak eyiko'.
Tato junnhej testigo t'a spatik junok anima tz'och smul, max yal-laj yoch t'a yib'anh. Masanto ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och t'a yib'anh jun ay smul chi'.
K'inalok ay junok chuk spensar syik'cha'anh junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok mach yik syik'ankot t'a yib'anh.
Tato icha chi', yowalil tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová, haton t'a yichanh heb' sacerdote yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio.
Ha heb' ayoch yajalil chi', a heb' sch'olb'itani tato yel jun lolonel chi', mato es syik'cha'anh jun anima t'a spatik junxo chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun tz'esan chi', hata' tz'ochkan jantak tas ix snib'ej yak'och t'a yib'anh junxo anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwi jun esalwumal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' anima, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a junok esalwum chi'. Icha wal tas snib'ej t'a spatik yetanimail chi', icha chi' tz'utaji. Tato snib'ej to smak'jicham jun yetanimail chi', ma tz'ik'jielta yol sat, ma smak'jiel ye, ma xikjiel sk'ab', ma yok, icha wal snib'ej tz'utaj jun anima chi', icha chi' tz'utaji.
